cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(mps_fixture_native LANGUAGES CXX)
find_package(Python REQUIRED COMPONENTS Interpreter Development.Module)
find_package(pybind11 CONFIG REQUIRED)
pybind11_add_module(_core core.cpp)
if(MINGW)
    enable_language(Fortran)
    if(NOT CMAKE_Fortran_ABI_COMPILED)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Fortran ABI detection failed: inspect the native toolchain PATH")
    endif()
    target_sources(_core PRIVATE add.f90)
    target_compile_definitions(_core PRIVATE MPS_FORTRAN_FIXTURE)
endif()
install(TARGETS _core LIBRARY DESTINATION mps_fixture_native RUNTIME DESTINATION mps_fixture_native)
